main_idea: AfterQuery and Legora built BAR, a broad benchmark for end-to-end legal work.
ideas: BAR covers 5,161 cases across 28 practice areas.
BAR-informed harness changes improved output quality by 5% in one month.
The cases reflect realistic legal matters.
summary: The long subtitle, separate quality improvement result, navigation, and repeated footer branding add clutter; nothing essential is missing.
